messages.content: Write a rigorous engineering memo for a team optimizing inference on a unified-memory accelerator. Analyze memory bandwidth, arithmetic intensity, KV-cache layout, quantization, speculative decoding, batching, latency, and measurement errors. Build the argument step by step, include concrete equations and examples, discuss counterarguments, and finish with a prioritized experimental plan. Aim for a detailed answer of at least 1,200 words without repeating paragraphs.

Verfasse eine ausführliche, klar gegliederte Analyse darüber, wie eine weiterführende Schule ein lokales KI-System verantwortungsvoll einsetzen kann. Behandle Datenschutz, Didaktik, Prüfungen, Barrierefreiheit, Betrieb, Kosten, Evaluation und konkrete Unterrichtsszenarien. Begründe Zielkonflikte, nenne messbare Kriterien und schließe mit einem realistischen Einführungsplan. Schreibe mindestens 1.200 Wörter und vermeide Wiederholungen.

Design and implement a production-quality Python 3 module for a bounded asynchronous job scheduler using only the standard library. It must support priorities, cancellation, per-job timeouts, graceful shutdown, backpressure, structured result records, and deterministic tests. Explain the invariants and race conditions, then provide the complete implementation and a comprehensive unittest suite. Be detailed and do not abbreviate code.

Produce a self-contained decision record comparing three architectures for serving a 120B mixture-of-experts language model on a single unified-memory workstation. Use sections Context, Assumptions, Options, Quantitative Model, Risks, Decision, Validation Matrix, Rollback, and Open Questions. Include at least one table, explicit numerical estimates, and a 12-step validation matrix. Write a substantial non-repetitive response.
